title: 回
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L170 回. Latest origin/main at handoff is complete through L165 先; L170 depends on L166 洗, L167 又, L168 髒, and L169 亂. Do not merge production JSON, planner-data, or ledger until L166-L169 are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 洗, 又, 髒, 亂. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; use 裡 not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 服, 弄, 完, 修, 丑, 找回, 回收, 整理, 收拾, 迷, or 丟. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
